# er605_dhcp_reservation (Resource)

Network > LAN > DHCP static address reservation (keyed by MAC, format AA-BB-CC-DD-EE-FF).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interface` (String) e.g. LAN1
- `ip` (String)
- `mac` (String)

### Optional

- `bind` (Boolean) also create the IP-MAC binding
- `enable` (Boolean)
- `note` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
